Noti is an all-in-one productivity workspace designed to centralize your personal task structures, organized checklist trackers, and note-taking configurations effortlessly.
Why am I getting a registration error?
This usually happens if the email or username is already tied to an existing account. Double-check your inputs or use the Login screen if you have already signed up.

Can I use Noti completely offline?
Core application screens allow quick reference caching, but active account generation, image synchronization, and backup routines require an active internet connection.
